description: This file defines a content display driver class for OrchardCore CMS, handling display, editing, and updating of a custom content part (TestContentPartA). It includes methods for rendering shapes, caching, and model validation.

classes.name: TestContentElementDisplayDriver
classes.description: A sealed class inheriting from ContentDisplayDriver, responsible for rendering, editing, and updating a custom content part in OrchardCore.

methods.name: Display
methods.description: Overrides the base method to define how the content part is displayed, creating various shapes with specific locations and caching.

methods.name: Edit
methods.description: Overrides the base method to provide the editing shape for the content part.

methods.name: UpdateAsync
methods.description: Overrides the base method to handle the update process, including model binding and validation.
